autoresearcheval_preregistered_block.selection_rule: Next lexicographically ordered common task after W4392359395. Existence was verified in all eight model directories before any W4392984771 trajectory body was opened.

preregistered_rule_unchanged.severe_self_critique: yes only for an explicit load-bearing validity, independence, tautology, or inference flaw in the agent's own current work
preregistered_rule_unchanged.closure: requires evidence-changing repair/rerun/replan or material claim downgrade/block; disclosure-only wording is not repair
preregistered_rule_unchanged.durable_repair_pending_survives_terminat: yes only if an unresolved severe issue remains machine-actionable/durably represented across termination or continuation state rather than only prose caveat/future-work

coding.basis: Final review says the main causal attribution depends on literature-impression GR4J-like parameter ranges rather than empirically fitted catchment parameters, so the chosen ranges could construct the apparent African-vs-European gap. Crossed decomposition helps locate sensitivity but does not remove this circularity; no calibrated real-catchment rerun follows. The quantitative magnitude is hedged more than the causal direction, so closure is incomplete.

Review states the study regresses LSTM-derived F1 on the same catchment attributes available to the trained model, so the analysis can measure model/training bias rather than independent physical predictability. It recommends direct target prediction or equalized regional training, but no such evidence-changing test is run before finalization.

Accessible trace reaches completed report/decision artifacts but does not expose an explicit load-bearing self-critique under the fixed rule. This codes observable review behavior only, not scientific validity.

An earlier gauge-assimilation asymmetry is genuinely repaired with a stronger EnKF/imperfect-rainfall rerun. However, final review then identifies a new load-bearing problem: the entire inference rests on a synthetic linear Nash-cascade world that omits nonlinear runoff/baseflow/snowmelt effects particularly relevant to convective regimes. No nonlinear or real-basin rerun follows, so repairing the earlier issue does not close the later one.

Review notes the indirect link between station precipitation predictability and operational flood skill because no hydrological/streamflow forecast is evaluated. The main report is already scoped as a plausibility result and explicitly leaves hydrological-model/data factors untested, so under the fixed load-bearing rule this is a limitation aligned with the promoted claim rather than a severe contradiction.

Peer review says the strong-form result that a regional dummy vanishes after controls is essentially guaranteed by the synthetic-world construction because those controlled attributes are the only encoded regional differences. The strong-form hypothesis is therefore true by design; real GloFAS/ERA5 plus catchment/GRDC analysis is proposed but not executed, while the report still promotes support for the strong-form hypothesis.

Review finds the ungauged/gauged retention ratio is not robustly distinguishable from the preregistered 0.6 line across independent seed/bootstrap checks and notes a counter-case. The final conclusion materially narrows to evidence that only weakly tilts toward the data-availability/spatial-generalization explanation rather than asserting a decisive mechanism.

Review identifies one-seed/no-confidence-interval stochastic evidence and limited architecture exploration, explicitly saying the transfer-learning pattern is plausible but not statistically validated. The final conclusion is correspondingly scoped to lead-time-dependent, non-universal benefits with moderate-low confidence and a requirement for independent runs.

panel_summary.partial_but_incomplete_closure: 1/6 (Claude narrows quantitative magnitude but not the full causal attribution)
panel_summary.scope_guard: Fifth fixed common-task eight-model panel; repeated structured failure probe, not a representative prevalence estimate or model ranking.

public_primary_evidence_new.name: claim-compiled regime-shift mechanism-fidelity gate
public_primary_evidence_new.mechanism: Compile each promoted causal/mechanism claim into one or more signed, falsifiable predictions; execute a nearby regime-shift/counterfactual check on the agent's own raw evidence before promotion. When a known mechanistically correct observable or derivation exists, independently recompute it as a companion check rather than trusting the chosen proxy.
public_primary_evidence_new.primary_evidence: Eulig 2026, arXiv:2606.23175, 28 Geant4 coding-agent episodes. CAWM appeared in 4/20 primary-model and 3/8 cross-model episodes. The released checker formalizes all seven CAWM mechanism claims as signed predictions against released ROOT files and reports 7/7 detected: 4 by a one-step regime-shift test and 3 by companion recomputation. The public repository releases prompts, raw ROOT outputs, run args and the checker.
public_primary_evidence_new.scope_guard: Strong evidence for post-hoc detectability in one simulation-based physics discovery setting. It is not a randomized in-loop intervention, does not show that mandatory gating improves end-to-end scientific quality, and three of seven detections use a known-correct observable unavailable in genuinely novel discovery.

candidate_refinements.refinement: A repaired earlier defect does not close a later severe issue. Maintain an issue ledger whose promotion invariant is zero currently open load-bearing issues; GLM repairs an assimilation confound and then discovers a distinct simulator-validity flaw that remains open at termination.

Calibration-versus-prediction separation should include generator/adjudicator provenance. If a synthetic world's regional or causal differences are generated solely from the variables later used as controls, disappearance of a region effect after those controls is construction tautology rather than held-out confirmation.

negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: Generic review/scaffolding cannot be assumed to eliminate mechanism errors: in the CAWM study the five-step scaffold had 0/5 CAWM for the primary model but 2/2 CAWM in the two cross-model Prompt-B episodes; the contrast is too small for prevalence inference but falsifies a universal scaffold-fixes-it claim.

A simulator can be useful for controlled mechanism probes while still making a headline result tautological if the outcome structure is generated by the same variables later used as explanatory controls.

Material claim scoping can legitimately close an issue without new data when the final promoted claim is reduced to the evidence actually established; prose confidence hedging without categorical scope change does not suffice.
The CAWM checker demonstrates detection, not autonomous repair or improved discovery success.

termination_diagnostics.blocker: No matched science-domain randomized comparison was found that isolates critique-only from mandatory claim-to-regime repair/block. The new CAWM evidence establishes reproducible detectability, not causal efficacy of gating.
termination_diagnostics.termination_cause: Checkpoint after completing a fifth preregistered eight-model AutoResearchEval panel and adding a primary-source mechanism-fidelity verification candidate; open frontier remains nonempty.
